world.title: The mission to recover Nims Purja's body from Broad Peak
world.summary: Mingma Gyalje Sherpa is leading a mission to recover the bodies of his friends, including renowned climber Nirmal Purja, who died in an avalanche on Broad Peak. As he navigates the treacherous terrain, he reflects on their shared climbing experiences. The mission is emotionally challenging, highlighting the risks and dangers faced by mountaineers in extreme conditions.

world.title: Saudi Arabia closes East-West oil pipeline after attacks in Riyadh, Madinah: ‘precautionary measure’
world.summary: Saudi Arabia has closed the East-West oil pipeline following multiple attacks in Riyadh and Madinah that resulted in injuries. The government described the closure as a precautionary measure to ensure safety. The decision reflects ongoing security concerns in the region, highlighting the potential impact of violence on critical infrastructure. Further developments are anticipated as the situation unfolds.

world.title: Twenty-five years after September 11, Americans reflect on attack that changed a nation
world.summary: Americans commemorated the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks on Friday, reflecting on the tragedy that resulted in nearly 3,000 deaths. Ceremonies took place in New York, Washington, and Pennsylvania, honoring the victims of the hijacked planes that struck the World Trade Center, the Pentagon, and a field in Pennsylvania. The impact of the attacks continues to resonate today.

business.title: SC's 13 queries to FSSAI: 'Give details on shape, size, colour of food label'
business.summary: The Supreme Court of India has instructed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to provide specific details regarding the design of front-of-pack food warning labels. This includes information on their shape, size, color, and placement. Justice JB Pardiwala raised concerns about FSSAI's two-phased approach to implementing these labeling guidelines during the proceedings.

business.title: Shapoor Mistry eyes ₹25,000 crore in two years for part of SP's Tata stake
business.summary: Shapoor Mistry is pursuing ₹25,000 crore from Tata Sons for a portion of SP Group's stake. The proposal aims to generate cash while maintaining Tata Sons' private status. Ongoing discussions focus on transaction structure and valuation for a potential buyback. SP Group is under pressure from lenders and needs to monetize its holdings based on valuations and funding requirements.

business.title: Nvidia in talks to invest in Anthropic’s mega IPO: Sources
business.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in discussions to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering (IPO), potentially the largest in history. Sources indicate that Anthropic aims to raise around $100 billion, which could significantly enhance its valuation in the artificial intelligence sector. Nvidia's involvement as an anchor investor is part of these ongoing negotiations.

technology.title: RBLX: Collaborative tools, intelligent creation, and engine upgrades drive platform innovation and creator empowerment
technology.summary: RBLX has introduced significant updates to enhance its platform, including collaborative branch/merge features, intelligent asset generation, and advanced avatar tools. New engine capabilities such as native persistence, offline play, and improved visual fidelity have been implemented. Additionally, enhancements in testing, security, and community support are designed to empower creators and improve overall platform quality and user experience.

technology.title: Sony PlayStation dropped Hideo Kojima's Physint over budget concerns and missed deadlines: Report
technology.summary: PlayStation has reportedly withdrawn from Hideo Kojima's game Physint due to concerns over rising costs, missed deadlines, and long-term profitability. The decision has led to Xbox taking over publishing duties, thereby expanding its partnership with Kojima Productions. This shift marks a significant change in the development trajectory of the highly anticipated action-espionage title.

technology.title: Apple Launches $1,999 Foldable iPhone Duo, but Analysts Question Its Mass-Market Appeal
technology.summary: Apple Inc. has launched its $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo, entering the foldable phone market. The device is designed to run work, entertainment, and creative applications across its larger screen. However, analysts are questioning its mass-market appeal, suggesting that Apple needs to clarify the target audience for this high-priced product as it competes in a growing segment.

sports.title: 'Future captain, maybe?': Ishan Kishan's banter with 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi goes viral - WATCH
sports.summary: Ishan Kishan and 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi engaged in lighthearted banter following East Zone's victory in the Duleep Trophy 2026/27. Kishan, who captained the team, celebrated the win and interacted with Sooryavanshi, highlighting a memorable moment. The exchange has since gone viral, showcasing the camaraderie and spirit of the players after their successful tournament performance.

sports.title: Alexander Zverev holds his nerve against Karen Khachanov to reach US Open final
sports.summary: Alexander Zverev advanced to the US Open final after defeating Karen Khachanov in a closely contested semi-final match. Zverev won with scores of 6-3, 7-6 (7), and 7-6 (6), marking his third consecutive appearance in a grand slam final. The match showcased Zverev's resilience, particularly after overcoming a set and break deficit during the intense encounter.

sports.title: Mourinho: “Right now we have a Vinícius Júnior who is working harder than ever”
sports.summary: Real Madrid coach José Mourinho praised Vinícius Júnior in a pre-match press conference ahead of the game against Rayo Vallecano. He emphasized the player's hard work and dedication, referencing proverbs to illustrate his commitment. Mourinho's comments highlight the importance of Vinícius to the team as they prepare for the upcoming match, showcasing the player's development and effort.

health.title: Paracetamol in pregnancy may affect daughters’ ovarian development and future fertility, new study suggests: What we know
health.summary: A new study suggests that paracetamol use during pregnancy may impact daughters' ovarian development and future fertility. This research raises concerns about the common pain reliever, which has been widely used for various ailments. The findings highlight the need for further investigation into the potential long-term effects of paracetamol on reproductive health in female offspring.

health.title: Do you wake up at night to urinate? Here’s the number of times considered normal by experts
health.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
health.summary: Nocturia, the need to wake at night to urinate, affects approximately 50 million adults in the U.S. Prevalence rates vary, with 10-20% of individuals aged 40-59 experiencing it, and over 50% in those over 60. Experts suggest that waking up once or twice per night is generally considered normal, while more frequent occurrences may indicate underlying health issues.

science.title: Wheel-less Spherical Rover Rolls Toward Mission to Find Ice in Lunar Crater
science.summary: Researchers at Texas A&M University have created RoboBall, a spherical rover designed for lunar exploration. Unlike traditional rovers, it has no wheels or legs, allowing it to roll and bounce through permanently shadowed areas of the Moon. The mission aims to locate ice deposits, enhancing our understanding of lunar resources and potential for future exploration.

science.title: Compost microbe yields enzyme that tackles polyurethane foam and nylon
science.summary: Researchers from Aarhus University and the Danish Technological Institute have identified 12 enzymes from bacteria collected in various locations, including a landfill in Kenya and a compost heap in Denmark. These enzymes show potential for breaking down challenging plastics like polyurethane foam and nylon, marking a significant advancement in efforts to improve plastic recycling and reduce environmental impact.

science.title: 'An exciting event:' Dark matter or not, new SURF discovery marks potential breakthrough
science.summary: Scientists at the Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) announced a potential breakthrough in particle discovery, though they have not confirmed the existence of dark matter. Julia Delgaudio, an engineering specialist, described the finding as an “exciting event.” Researchers believe they may have identified a novel particle, which could have significant implications for understanding fundamental physics.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: September 12, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 12, 2026, Leos are encouraged to embrace their true selves amidst worldly worries causing anxiety. The horoscope suggests that this period is an opportunity for self-acceptance, allowing individuals to express their identity without the pressure of conforming to societal expectations. The focus is on personal growth and authenticity, fostering a supportive environment for self-discovery.

entertainment.summary: Capricorns are advised to take a step back and recharge, reflecting on their emotional experiences. The horoscope suggests that personal challenges vary for each individual, emphasizing the importance of self-care. This period is seen as an opportunity for rest and recuperation, allowing Capricorns to regain their strength and perspective. Taking time off is encouraged for overall well-being.
